这个页面不能在桌面面板中打开: This page cannot be opened in a desktop panel
已恢复默认布局；{0} 个面板有未保存的修改，保持打开: Default layout restored; {0} panel(s) with unsaved changes stay open
在左侧导航右键页面可「摘出到桌面」。恢复默认布局会合回全部面板并清除保存的位置。: Right-click a page in the left navigation to "Detach to desktop". Restoring the default layout returns all panels to the main window and clears their saved positions.
合回全部桌面面板并清除保存的位置？: Return all desktop panels to the main window and clear their saved positions?
登录 Windows 时启动 infOS 客户端: Start the infOS client when signing in to Windows
只有打包后的客户端可以设置开机启动。: Only the packaged client can start at login.
启动客户端时同时启动后端: Start the backend together with the client
客户端启动时如果本机后端没有运行，会打开所选程序（例如「只启动后端.bat」）并: When the client starts and the local backend is not running, it opens the chosen program (for example 只启动后端.bat) and waits for the backend. Only you can choose it here; characters cannot change it.
当前连接的是远程服务器，不会启动本机后端。: Connected to a remote server; the local backend will not be started.
在卡片窗口中按 Ctrl+W 也可以关闭卡片。: You can also press Ctrl+W in a card window to close it.
删除卡片「{0}」？此操作不能撤销。: Delete card "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
启动 infOS 时自动打开（会一并收藏）: Open automatically when infOS starts (also saves the card)
角色为你做的桌面小卡片都在这里: All the desktop cards your characters made for you
卡片只在桌面版中可用。: Cards are only available in the desktop app.
还没有卡片。可以请角色帮你做一张，比如待办或倒计时。: No cards yet. Ask a character to make one, such as a to-do list or a countdown.
没收藏的卡片关闭后在这里保留 7 天，收藏后就会一直留着。: Unsaved cards stay here for 7 days after closing. Save one to keep it.
打开、收藏、改名、删除和找回最近关闭的卡片，都在「卡片」页。: Open, save, rename, delete and recover recently closed cards on the Cards page.
把桌面图标分组收进半透明的框里，可折叠、置顶、拖动和缩放；框里只是引用，不会移动: Group desktop icons into translucent fences you can collapse, pin, move and resize. Fences only hold references and never move your files.
